# Open Corpus: Reboot Democracy and InnovateUS

> An open, machine-readable index of content from Reboot Democracy (rebootdemocracy.ai) and InnovateUS (innovate-us.org): blog posts, weekly news digests, workshops, workshop recordings and courses. Every entry links to the original page.

Full catalog: data/sources.json (838 entries, one per line) and data/sources.csv. Cite each entry's `url`.

- [Reboot Democracy — Blog posts](lists/reboot-democracy--blog-post.md): 347 entries, 2023-06 – 2026-10
- [Reboot Democracy — Weekly news digests](lists/reboot-democracy--news-digest.md): 115 entries, 2025-04 – 2026-09
- [InnovateUS — Workshops](lists/innovateus--workshop.md): 368 entries, 2021-12 – 2026-12
- [InnovateUS — Courses](lists/innovateus--course.md): 8 entries
